purpose: the A3 done-when: a Vietnamese pitch yields <name>.en.md and a glossary from the loop
pitch: the one-page-site pitch written in Vietnamese (pitch.vi.md)
produced_by_the_loop: pitch.en.md (the English copy, beside the pitch)
shapeup/personal-site/shaping/glossary.md (source term / English / note, with the two senses of one Vietnamese word kept apart)
not_measured: one pitch, one run; no judgement is made here of the translation's quality beyond the glossary existing and the run opening on the English copy
